cohort: A study of 262 mother-infant pairs, where the infants were neonates delivered at specific health facilities in the Dodoma Region, Tanzania, during the study period.
finding: Infants born with birth asphyxia were three times more likely to develop delayed developmental milestones compared to those without birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: Infants born via caesarean section had a lower risk of developing delayed developmental milestones compared to those born via spontaneous vaginal delivery.
